title: What If You Unraveled All the DNA in Your Body?

scenes.text: What if you unraveled all your DNA? It would reach the Sun and back.
Each cell packs about two meters, six feet, of DNA, coiled so tightly it fits inside a nucleus far too small to see.
You have trillions of cells. Even a low estimate of ten trillion will do.
Add it up, and it's about ten billion miles of DNA in one person.
The Sun is about 93 million miles away. One person's DNA could make the round trip more than 60 times.
And it all fits inside you, because it's folded.
